description:
Answer 'when is <movie> coming to OTT / Netflix / Prime in <country>' for OTTASIA's Asian, Middle Eastern and diaspora markets.

If the title already streams in that country, returns the services. If not, returns OTTASIA's predicted streaming date (from historical theatrical-to-OTT gaps, with a confidence level) when one exists, plus a link where the user can set a free alert for the day it lands.
Use where_to_watch for plain availability questions; use this when the user asks WHEN.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, PK, BD, AE, US). Defaults to IN.

title.description: Movie or show name, e.g. 'Kantara Chapter 1', 'Coolie', 'Saiyaara'.

name: when_streaming
